blocks.text: Architecting a Secure 'Work from Anywhere' Platform for a Global Retail Leader
Retail & Distribution

blocks.alt: person wearing long-sleeve top working on laptop

blocks.text: Client
A century-old global leader in retail and distribution with a sharp focus on innovative branding and quality.
Ambition
To empower a rapidly expanding global workforce with secure, high-performance access to corporate data and applications from any device, anywhere.
Outcome

Architected a centralized desktop and application delivery solution that enhanced user productivity, strengthened security, ensured high availability, and eliminated the challenges of a traditional VPN.
The Ambition
A century-old global leader in retail and distribution with a sharp focus on innovative branding and quality.
The Challenge

Rapid global expansion had stretched their IT capabilities. A traditional VPN solution was causing severe performance issues and user complaints. It lacked the granular security controls needed to manage data leakage, control endpoints, and track user access effectively, posing a significant risk to the business and hindering the rollout of a formal BYOD program.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to maintain their market leadership by enabling a modern, agile, and mobile workforce. They needed to provide seamless and secure access to critical business applications, including a thick ERP client, for employees and vendor partners in remote locations across the globe, supporting a new BYOD policy without compromising their security posture.
Ambition, Realized

The new architecture transformed their ability to support a global workforce. Employees and partners now have a secure, high-performance 'work from anywhere' experience. The IT team gained comprehensive control and visibility over data and applications, enabling a successful BYOD rollout while strengthening their security posture. The elimination of VPN-related performance issues and the assurance of 99.99% uptime for critical servers significantly boosted user productivity and satisfaction.
Key Business Impact
Enabled a Secure 'Work from Anywhere' & BYOD Strategy
Enhanced Application Performance for Global Users
Strengthened Data Security & Centralized Control
Achieved High Availability for Mission-Critical Servers
